events.title: v1.13.3 Update — LUCA's new look, new rewards

events.title: v1.13.1 Balance Patch: stronger passives, stage 1 boss HP
events.summary: Rush Girl Luca is participating in the Steam Next Fest! Until October 27, try out the free demo to mix and match weapon tags and create your own unique weapon. If you like it, please show your support by adding it to your Wishlist.We’ve released balance patch v1.13.1 in time for the Next Fest.PassivesBuying the same passive again costs less (x1.5 / x2 of the base price, was x2 / x3).Beam Thruster: dash speed +30% (was +20%).Balance Wing: movement speed +15% (was +10%).Hyper Sensor: dodge window

events.title: v1.13.0 — Tighter fights, an economy that rewards skill
events.summary: NewRound end: the doctor's jamming signal sweeps the screen from Earth and every drone powers off and falls.Clear bonuses: finishing a round pays a clear bonus. Ending on rank A or S adds to it, and taking no hit adds a no-damage bonus. Boss rounds pay double.Boss entrances: both bosses arrive with a warning banner and a camera move.Stage transition: LUCA climbs through the cloud bank between stages.
